## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Save failures should be surfaced because an unavailable destination currently produces a success message and returns zero. This review read both changed files and their tests; no tests were run. Cleanup correctly ignores absent files while preserving other errors.

## Changes
The pull request adds report saving with a destination announcement and cleanup for optional temporary reports. It adds tests for saving and cleanup.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Surface write failures before announcing success — When the destination’s parent directory does not exist, `save_report` discards `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns zero. The broad `OSError` handler also hides permission and storage failures. The unavailable-destination test only calls the function and does not check failure reporting. — Users and callers receive a success message and zero status even though the report was not saved. — Fix: Propagate the write error, or provide an actionable diagnostic and nonzero status; announce success only after writing succeeds.
